intent: Add a real four bridge-neck Gmsh/Elmer thermal model and connect it to the Rust Zapote harness with exact source geometry, energy/convergence/sensitivity checks, stale-evidence protection, and current binding. Preserve conditional applicability and existing IPC/current failures while committing the power-entry copper repair.

learnings.title: Model certificates need semantic binding as well as artifact hashes
learnings.note: The replay and mutation checks bind saved board, native, geometry and raw outputs semantically.

learnings.title: Solver-independence is not model-independence for validation oracles
learnings.note: The documentation preserves the FEM model boundary and does not present it as assembled-cooker corroboration.

learnings.title: External-FEM corroboration is a validity-proxy, not a soundness proof
learnings.note: The change keeps hardware qualification and cooling applicability explicitly unresolved.

learnings.title: Qualification exports require clean-build replay
learnings.note: The retained bundle and replay path preserve generated inputs, logs, hashes and semantic mutation controls.

learnings.title: A runnable behavioral model is evidence only inside its declared boundary
learnings.note: The harness reports numerical evidence while leaving package, enclosure and cooling limits indeterminate.

learnings.title: Thermal models need complete connectivity and scoped sensor ratings
learnings.note: The bridge model binds exact trace and pad identities and does not infer a component rating from the local solve.

residual_risks: The thermal harness keeps a second private net-to-trace/segment identity map in zapote/packages/zapote-harness/src/bridge_thermal.rs:200 while neck_geometry.rs owns the corresponding bridge definitions. A future bridge repair can update one map without the other and make current binding drift; consolidate the mapping or add a cross-module consistency check when this area next changes.

A numerical thermal replay remains conditional: bridge package, solder, rest-board temperatures, assembly cooling and allowable temperature limits are not qualified, so the applicability rule must remain INDETERMINATE until those inputs are bounded by an assembly model or measurement.
testing_gaps: The tracked runner integration test rebases source/native/board and other manifest inputs but does not rebase thermal_evidence or invoke runner::run for the PowerEntry entry; add a manifest-level test that resolves the configured evidence directory and proves the numerical replay rule executes through the adopted unit-run path.

current_tree_suppressions: Manifest never supplies thermal evidence (units.json now supplies it and zapote-unit-run rebases it).
Fail missing configured thermal evidence (Some(missing) now emits Finding::fail, with regression coverage).
Mesher ignores extracted pad shape (native bridge geometry validation now checks saved/native shapes and neck_run invokes it).
Replay evidence path lacks end-to-end tests (retained replay and harness mutation tests now exercise the path).
Replay ignores solver execution receipts (verify_commands now checks every per-case receipt and stdout/stderr log equality).
branch_current starts_with collision (exact-ID matching and a collision regression are now present).
discarded_contract_or_preference_claims: Replay backend rehash: the documented replay contract is portable historical evidence; normal cargo tests run without Gmsh/Elmer, and backend hashes are provenance rather than a live installation allowlist.
Scattered raw mesh tags: 1/2/11/12/13 are the intentional Gmsh/Elmer protocol, with structural tag mutation coverage; centralizing them would be cleanup preference without a demonstrated defect.

validator.reason: No primary P0/P1 or actionable finding survived current-tree reconciliation.
